plugins.readme_text:
# Chart · dsh-chart

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A DeepSeek Harness tab that **turns one real session into a reusable skill.**

A conversation is a route you already walked: the commands that worked, the file that finally fixed it, the check that proved it, and the dead end you backed out of. Usually all of that scrolls away. Chart reads the session log, keeps what worked, and drafts a standard `SKILL.md` — the same kind of skill file DSH loads for future sessions.

No new model calls, no guessing. Every step in the draft traces back to an event in that session.

## What you see once installed

Open any conversation with history and pick the **Chart** tab at the top. The page has two halves: evidence on the left, the skill draft on the right.

### Seven numbers

Turns, usable steps, checks, failed commands, files changed, commands run, and raw events.

All of them are counted from the log. Nothing is estimated.

### What the session left behind

- **Goal** — what you asked for in the first prompt, plus the session title and the agent preset.
- **Steps** — commands that actually succeeded, in order. Housekeeping like `cd`, `ls` and `pwd` is dropped, duplicates are merged, and each step shows which turn it came from. At most `maxSteps` (30 by default).
- **Checks** — commands that verify the work: tests, lint, typecheck, build, e2e, plus reachability checks such as `curl` or `git ls-remote`. A command lands here only when it succeeded, and only when *every* chained part is a real check (`npm run lint && tsc --noEmit` counts; `rm -rf dist && npm test` does not).
- **Files changed** — only files a successful edit or write touched, with how many times.
- **Pitfalls** — commands that failed, the error they gave, and whether a later retry worked. If it never worked, the draft says so instead of pretending it was fixed.
- **Before you start** — OS, shell, package manager, whether git was used, and the workspace path. All read from the log; missing facts stay missing.

### The draft

The right column holds a normal Markdown skill file you can review before anything is saved:

- **Name** — this becomes the folder name. Chart picks a free name automatically, so saving a second draft never silently replaces the first.
- **Include switches** — steps, checks, files, pitfalls, before-you-start notes, the goal. Turning one off regenerates the draft.
- **Editor** — edit the Markdown directly. Once you type, the draft stops regenerating by itself; the **Regenerate** button is there when you want it, and warns that it will replace your edits. The frontmatter `name` stays in sync with the folder name.
- **Copy** — puts the Markdown on your clipboard.
- **Download** — saves `SKILL.md` to your downloads folder.
- **Save to skill library** — writes the file into the local skill library. The dialog shows the exact path first. If a skill with that name already exists, saving stays disabled until you tick **overwrite**, and the old file is backed up before it is replaced.

After saving, the tab shows where the file went, where the backup went, and whether anything was masked again at write time.

## Where the skill goes

```text
~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md          # default
$DSH_HOME/skills/<name>/SKILL.md       # when DSH_HOME is set
```

That is the user skill root DSH already scans. Skills written there are discovered automatically, so a new session can use them. Chart writes nowhere else, and never writes a half-finished file — content goes to a temporary file and is renamed into place.

## Privacy: it will not leak your keys

Sessions often contain keys, tokens and email addresses. Everything is cleaned up **on your machine, before it reaches the page**:

- Private key blocks, JWTs, GitHub / AWS / Google / Slack / npm / PyPI / Stripe / DeepSeek-shaped keys, `Bearer` headers, credentials inside URLs, `api_key = …` assignments and email addresses become `«已脱敏»`.
- The tab reports how many spans were masked and which families fired. It does not show the secrets.
- The file is **redacted a second time at write time**, so hand edits cannot accidentally reintroduce a key.
- Things that only look secret are left alone: `process.env.X`, `${TEMPLATE}`, `foo.bar.baz`, `ALL_CAPS_CONSTANTS`, and short strings.
- Automatic redaction is on by default. If you turn it off, the page and the save dialog both say so instead of pretending it ran.

Nothing is uploaded. The plugin reads the current session through Harness's own `sessionQuery` and writes only under the skill root.

## Install

Requires Node.js 22.19+ (or 24+) and DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6+.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xh0915/dsh-chart
cd dsh-chart
pnpm install
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Restart the Web Harness. Open a conversation with history and the **Chart** tab is there.

**`pnpm run build` must run before `add`.** The package ships no install-time build script (pnpm 10 blocks unapproved `prepare` scripts); skip this step and the plugin installs but fails to load.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chart
```

## Settings

```yaml
dsh-chart:
  redactSecrets: true   # mask secrets before they reach the page (default)
  maxSteps: 30          # commands kept as reusable steps, 5–200
```

When a session has more successful commands than the budget, the draft keeps the first `maxSteps` in order and adds a note saying some were omitted. Nothing is dropped silently. Checks, pitfalls, and changed files have their own fixed caps (12, 12, and 24); the same note appears when one of them is reached.

## Boundaries

- **Only real evidence.** A step exists because a tool call succeeded; a pitfall exists because one failed; a file exists because an edit or write was applied. Nothing is inferred from prose.
- **No failure text, no pitfall row.** If a failed command left no error text at all, it is still counted as a failure but not written into the skill, rather than invented.
- **No checks that did not pass.** Verification commands that failed are not offered as checks.
- **No skill discovery fiction.** The skill is saved to the user skill root DSH actually scans; preset-local folders are left alone.
- **The plugin itself stays offline.** No model request, no shell call, no telemetry. It is UI over your own data.
- **No cost figure.** The log has no price, so the plugin does not guess one.
- The UI follows Harness light and dark themes, and speaks Chinese and English.

## Technical details

<details>
<summary>For people changing the code</summary>

### Layout

```text
package.json           # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client, scripts, peer deps
cordis.patch.yml       # mounts the host plugin row into a profile
dsh.plugin.json        # registry manifest
src/index.ts           # host entry: Config schema, ChartRuntime, Typert manifest
src/runtime.ts         # chart.build / chart.library / chart.save
src/distill.ts         # session log -> goal, steps, checks, files, pitfalls, env
src/library.ts         # local skill root: parse, list, save, backup
src/redact.ts          # local secret redaction
src/schema.ts          # Zod wire authority (types inferred, nothing drifts)
src/contract.ts        # strict InvocationDescriptor shared by host and client
src/typert.ts          # host reflection manifest
src/client/index.tsx   # client entry: mounts the Remote, registers the tab
src/client/view.tsx    # the Chart view
src/client/skill.ts    # SKILL.md markdown builder + frontmatter sync
src/client/styles.ts   # theme-token stylesheet (follows Harness light/dark)
src/client/locales.ts  # zh / en copy
tests/                 # distillation, library, markdown, contract, client-entry tests
build.mjs              # esbuild dual build: host ESM + client wrapped for the web loader
```

The client half contributes **no** prompt, tool, or session event — `ctx.typert.register()` only publishes reflection metadata. The plugin is UI over your own data.

### Development

```sh
pnpm run check   # typecheck + lint + test + build
```

### Renaming

If you fork this and rename it, keep these in sync: `package.json` → `name`, `exports`, `files`; `build.mjs` → the `__ModuleLoader__.load` id; `s

plugins.description: Ultracode for DeepSeek Harness: dynamic standard-preset inheritance, bounded multi-agent workflows, floating progress viewer, and subtle composer glow.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ultracode for DeepSeek Harness

为 DSH 添加多 Agent 工作流预设、固定悬浮进度卡片和输入框模式微光。模型与思考强度沿用 DSH 的独立选择，不强制最高强度。

社区插件，与 Anthropic、OpenAI 无隶属关系；不包含 Claude Code 的专有代码。

![Ultracode 工作流与输入框模式微光](docs/images/ultracode-light.jpg)

## 功能

- 启动时动态继承当前标准预设，仅覆盖工作流编排策略、并发和总代理预算。
- 使用 DSH 原生工作流、子代理、后台任务和完成通知；后台任务结束后可唤醒主对话。
- 工作流卡片固定悬浮、可拖动和折叠，支持阶段、成员、执行结果和版本历史。
- 同一目标调整保留版本链，先结束旧执行再启动新版本；独立任务使用独立工作流。
- 切到 Ultracode 时，从输入框顶部正中播放开场流光；短暂停顿后淡入连续呼吸微光。切回其他模式清除，恢复已有会话不重播。

## 兼容与安装

已验证 DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2**。声明支持 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，未来宿主接口变化仍需重新验证。

从本仓库的 Release 下载 `.tgz`，在 DSH 的插件安装入口选择该安装包。CLI 用户可用：

[下载 v1.2.0](https://github.com/Srelka/dsh-ultracode/releases/tag/v1.2.0)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add ./srelka-dsh-ultracode-1.2.0.tgz
```

将 `web` 替换为实际使用的 profile。桌面端优先使用应用内插件管理入口。安装后完全退出并重新打开 DSH，在新会话的 Agent 预设中选择 **Ultracode**。

如果已经安装本地开发版 `@local/dsh-ultracode`，先通过 DSH 插件管理卸载该开发版，再安装本包，避免两个包同时注册同名预设。卸载插件不需要删除会话；本包沿用 `ultracode` 预设和历史标识。

当前宿主只允许空白会话切换预设，已有对话保留原模式。默认并发上限为 4，默认每个工作流总代理上限为 12，可调整但不超过 40。工作代理禁止继续递归委派。

## 配置

在 DSH 的用户覆盖层设置 `preset-ultracode`；覆盖该行时保留完整配置：

```yaml
- id: preset-ultracode
  name: '@srelka/dsh-ultracode/inherit'
  config:
    basePreset: standard
    maxConcurrentAgents: 4
    defaultAgentLimit: 12
    maxTotalAgents: 40
    replacementTimeoutMs: 30000
```

标准预设的修改在下次启动时继承，不做运行中热更新。详见 [设计与验证](docs/design-and-validation.md)。

## 开发与测试

使用与目标 DSH 运行时一致的 Node.js。安装依赖后，将 `ULTRACODE_TEST_RUNTIME` 指向具有 `node_modules` 的同版本 DSH 运行时目录，执行 `npm test`。该变量只供测试使用，插件通过宿主 Loader 获取原生接口。

只运行无需 DSH 依赖的模型和光效控制器测试：

```sh
node --test tests/model.test.mjs tests/composer-glow.test.mjs
```

运行模块已经是 JavaScript，不要求用户执行构建脚本。打包使用 `npm pack --ignore-scripts`。`private: true` 用于防止误发布到 npm，不影响 Git/安装包分发。

## 限制

任务拆分和结果质量取决于实际模型。进程崩溃后保留工作流历史，但不从脚本中间断点续跑。系统开启减少动态效果时只保留静态模式边缘。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。保留已有版权与许可声明。

plugins.description: Quota pill for DeepSeek Harness: how much is left on every LLM subscription, in one pill
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quota-pill

A quota pill for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web GUI:
**how much is left** on every LLM subscription you have, in one collapsible pill
next to the composer.

![quota pill](docs/screenshot.png)

It sits in the composer toolbar, shows the tightest window at a glance, and opens
into a per-provider breakdown with reset times. Switch sessions and it follows
the model — showing that provider's last reading while it refreshes, then easing
into the live number.

## What it reads

| Provider | Credential |
|---|---|
| **DeepSeek** (official) | the Platform sign-in DSH already holds — nothing to add |
| **Kimi Coding** | `refs.KIMI_CODING_API_KEY` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` |
| **OpenCode Go** | `refs.OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` |
| **Command Code** | `refs.COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` or `refs.COMMANDCODE_GOAT_API_KEY` (DSH names it after its `apiKeyEnv`) |
| **xAI (Grok)** | OAuth token from [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) |
| **Codex (ChatGPT Plus)** | same — and CLIProxyAPI must be **running** |
| **Antigravity** | same |
| **Open Design** (optional) | `refs.OPENDESIGN_CONTROL_KEY` (`vela_ctrl_…`) + `refs.OPENDESIGN_WORKSPACE_ID`; a console session cookie (`OPENDESIGN_SESSION_COOKIE`) also works as a fallback |

**DeepSeek works with no setup at all** if you are signed in to DeepSeek Platform
in DSH — that is the official account, and it is the one most users care about.

The three API-key providers need nothing but the key. The three OAuth providers
need CLIProxyAPI installed and logged in, because that is what holds the tokens;
this plugin only reads them and never runs an OAuth flow itself.

Every provider is optional, and **only the ones you actually have are listed**:
the pill reads DSH's `session/modelCatalog` to learn which providers the app can
route to, so removing a provider from DSH removes it from the pill too. A provider
that is present but has no credential is skipped rather than shown as an empty row.

### What "auto-detect" means

- **A new key for a supported provider** (e.g. adding `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`)
  appears on the next All refresh — no DSH restart, no sidecar restart.
- **A provider newly added to DSH's catalog** appears within the 2-minute catalog
  TTL, or immediately when you press **Refresh** / reopen the All page (a forced
  read drops the catalog cache). The All page also re-reads when DSH regains focus.
- **A brand-new provider type** that is not one of the eight adapters needs a
  **user adapter** in `~/.dsh/quota-pill/adapters/` (see below); a catalog entry
  alone cannot invent its quota API.

### Unknown providers and user adapters

If the Current page cannot read the session's provider, it shows a short hint and
a **复制提示词 / Copy prompt** button. The copied prompt contains the whole
adaptation flow; paste it into a new session and an agent can add the provider
without touching package files.

User adapters live in:

```text
~/.dsh/quota-pill/adapters/<provider>.mjs
```

They are outside the npm package, so **updating the plugin never overwrites
them**. The sidecar discovers a new/changed file on the next Refresh (no restart).
`/setup?fresh=1` reports `unadaptedCatalog` and `userAdapters`, and after a
plugin update the same check tells the agent which providers still need an
adapter. The module contract (exports, `read(ctx)`, standard kinds) is documented
in [`src/user-adapters.js`](src/user-adapters.js) and in AGENTS.md §2b.

## Install

**DSH Desktop (recommended).** Open **Plugins → Install**, paste a spec, enable
the bundle. **Pin the version**: an unpinned install can resolve 0.2.2, which
breaks web boot. 0.2.12 is the first version with every provider, Open Design
Control Keys, sidecar auto-start, and **user-defined adapters** for providers the
package does not ship.

```text
@hystudio/dsh-quota-pill@0.2.12
```

0.2.12 is published on npm. If pnpm's minimumReleaseAge rejects this fresh
release, install the branch until it ages:

```text
github:598934321/dsh-quota-pill#master
```

**CLI.** If `dsh` is not on PATH, open DSH Desktop → Settings → **Manage dsh
Command** first. Then:

```bash
dsh plugin add @hystudio/dsh-quota-pill@0.2.12
```

> The npm package is `@hystudio/...` while the repo lives at `598934321/...` —
> they are the same author under two account names.

**The sidecar now starts automatically with the plugin** (the host half spawns it
when nothing is listening on :8319), so there is no second command for a normal
desktop install. If you prefer to manage it yourself, run
`npx @hystudio/dsh-quota-pill` or a service unit — see
[Running it as a service](#running-it-as-a-service).
The pill says **"quota service is not running"** only if :8319 is still closed a
few seconds after DSH starts.

Then add whichever keys you have:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  KIMI_CODING_API_KEY: sk-...
  OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY: sk-...
  COMMANDCODE_API_KEY: sk-...
```

Reload the DSH window. Done.

### Let an agent do it

The repo ships [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) — a step-by-step guide written for an AI
agent. Ask your agent to set the plugin up and it will detect what you already
have, ask only for what it cannot know (your keys), write them safely, and verify
each provider end to end.

```text
Read AGENTS.md in this repo and set up dsh-quota-pill for me.
```

## Running it as a service

The host plugin already starts the sidecar; this section is only for users who
want it independent of DSH (server, headless, multiple app profiles). Set
`QUOTA_PILL_NO_AUTOSTART=1` so the plugin does not race the service.

`npx` in a terminal dies with the terminal. Pick one:

**macOS (launchd)** — `~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.quota-pill.plist`

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN"
  "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>dev.quota-pill</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/usr/bin/env</string><string>node</string>
    <string>/absolute/path/to/bin/quota-pill-server.js</string>
  </array>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
</dict></plist>
```

```bash
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.quota-pill.plist
```

**Linux (systemd)** — `~/.config/systemd/user/quota-pill.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=dsh-quota-pill sidecar

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env node /absolute/path/to/bin/quota-pill-server.js
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
```

```bash
systemctl --user enable --now quota-pill
```

## How it works

```
DSH web GUI
   └─ client.js          renders the pill; never sees a credential
        │  HTTP (localhost)
        ▼
      sidecar           reads ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml and ~/.cli-proxy-api/*.json,
                        calls each provider's quota endpoint, caches 60s
```

Two processes because credentials must never reach the browser, and because
upstream calls need real timeouts and a TLS stack Node's `fetch` does not have
for some hosts.

### Endpoints

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /health` | liveness + provider list |
| `GET /quota?model=<id>` | one provider's reading, selected by model prefix |
| `GET /quota/all` | every provider, concurrently |
| `GET /setup` | what each provider still needs |

`?fresh=1` bypasses the 60-second cache.

### Response

```jsonc
{
  "kind": "subscription-quota",   // subscription-quota | payg | none | probe-failed
  "provider": "opencode",
  "displayName": "OpenCode Go",
  "remainingPct": 17,             // remaining, never used
  "window": "monthly",            // the binding window
  "resetAt": "2026-11-12T00:00:00.000Z",
  "products": { "rolling": 9, "weekly": 67, "monthly": 83 },  // per-window used%
  "windows": [                    // one row each in the UI
    { "key": "monthly", "remainPct": 17, "resetAt": "..." }
  ],
  "cached": false,
  "at": 1792500000000
}
```

`kind` is meant to be exhaustive so the UI never has to guess:

- `subscription-quota` — a real percentage exists
- `payg` — metered billing, no ceiling (shows spend, not a percentage)
- `none` — not configured; `error` names the missing crede

plugins.description: REA
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-rea-toolkit

**One-line value:** after installing, your DeepSeek Harness agent gains the full [REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)](https://github.com/morluto/rea) toolset — evidence-backed static analysis of JavaScript/Electron applications, browser extensions, ASAR archives, .NET assemblies, native binaries, SQLite databases, WASM, EVM bytecode, and more — as native `mcp__rea__*` tools.

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/my-rea-toolkit)

## What it does

This bundle packages the **REA v6.7.0 runtime** (`dist/`, verified Windows native artifact, skills, and the exact dependency lockfile) together with a DeepSeek Harness **configuration-only MCP bundle** that registers REA's stdio MCP server through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. REA analyzes targets **locally**; results include per-conclusion evidence and limitations.

Typical agent prompts after install:

- *"Analyze the extracted extension at `D:/apps/legacy-ext` and list its modules, IPC channels and gateway endpoints with evidence."*
- *"Inspect this Electron app's ASAR and explain how the renderer talks to the main process."*

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/my-rea-toolkit
```

Then, inside the installed bundle directory, run the bootstrap **once** and restart DeepSeek Harness:

```sh
install-tools.bat      # Windows
./install-tools.sh     # Linux / macOS
node install-tools.mjs # directly
```

The bootstrap: discovers a suitable Node.js (22.19+/24.11+/26+), verifies the bundled REA runtime, installs REA's exact production dependencies from the shipped lockfile, persists `DSH_REA_HOME` / `DSH_REA_NODE` at user scope, and runs REA's own `mcp doctor`.

**Resolution contract** (see `cordis.patch.yml`):

| Environment | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_REA_NODE` + `DSH_REA_HOME` set | Absolute node + bundled, validated REA runtime (works with no system Node on PATH) |
| `DSH_REA_HOME` only | `node` from PATH + bundled runtime |
| Neither set | `npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 mcp` fetches the official runtime from npm |

Without any setup the bundle still installs safely — you simply get no REA tools until the bootstrap runs (or npm/npx is available).

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (shipped profile package).
- Windows 10+ x64 (uses the bundled verified `rea-windows-x64.node` Node-API addon; loader checks version/ABI/architecture/SHA-256 at load), Linux x64, macOS (Apple silicon: JS analysis lanes; native binary lanes per REA docs).
- Node.js 22.19+/24.11+/26+ (auto-discovered by the bootstrap; the bundled DeepSeek Harness runtime qualifies).

## Permissions & external services

- **Local-only analysis:** REA reads the target files/directories you point it at and writes nothing outside its own analysis sessions. It does not upload targets anywhere.
- **Network:** only optional — npm registry (first bootstrap / npx fallback) and analysis targets that the agent explicitly asks to inspect over the network (e.g., a website URL via the browser lane).
- **Execution scope:** static analysis lanes do not run the analyzed application. Runtime capture lanes (browser observation, process capture, frida) run only when an agent workflow explicitly invokes them, with the harness user's permissions.
- **Ambient secrets** (`*TOKEN*`, `*KEY*`, …) are scrubbed from the MCP child environment by the Harness MCP client.

## License

- Wrapper (bundle, scripts, manifest): **MIT** — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Bundled REA runtime: **MIT** — see [runtime/rea/LICENSE](runtime/rea/LICENSE), [runtime/rea/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](runtime/rea/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and [runtime/rea/DISCLAIMER.md](runtime/rea/DISCLAIMER.md). REA is for lawful analysis of software you own or are authorized to examine.

## Category

Development & Operations (secondary: Tools & Capabilities).

## Notes

- REA upstream: <https://github.com/morluto/rea> (not affiliated with this bundle).
- Native deep-analysis engines (Hopper / Ghidra / IDA) are bring-your-own and optional; JavaScript/extension analysis needs none of them.
- The `index.js` `apply(ctx)` export is an inert plugin-spec compliance shim; the bundle is configuration-only.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件 · 对话目录 · 搜索用户提问，跳转原文并保存阅读位置。
plugins.readme_text:
# 对话目录与快速定位

DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。在长对话里按问题找回上下文，而不用反复滚动。

- 只列出用户提问与补充提问，排除工具输出和系统注入。
- 搜索标题式预览和完整提问文字；多个关键词以空格分隔，可同时匹配。
- 点击问题跳回对应轮次，优先触发 DSH 原生轮次导航。
- 手动加载更早消息，明确显示搜索覆盖的已加载范围。
- 记住本机最近阅读的问题，点击“继续上次阅读”恢复；不会自动打断当前阅读位置。
- 支持深色、浅色主题和中英文界面。

## 安装与使用

需要 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x 版本**。

在 DSH 的“插件 → 添加插件”中填写：

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-conversation-outline
```

安装并启用后，按 DSH 提示重载。在会话输入框左侧工具栏选择“对话目录”（窄窗口中显示 `☷` 图标），搜索或点击某条提问。

命令行用户也可运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:yxue301603/dsh-conversation-outline`。桌面版请使用其自身的插件管理器。

整套安装、迁移和升级步骤见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

## 数据与边界

插件从 DSH 的公开会话与 Chat 快照读取当前会话的已加载提问，不扫描磁盘或其他会话、不访问网络、不调用模型、不发送消息。阅读记录只保存当前设备上的会话 ID、消息定位信息和时间，最多保留 100 个会话，不复制提问正文。卸载插件不会删除 DSH 原会话。

搜索不包含尚未加载的历史；使用“加载更早消息”可扩大搜索范围。定位依赖 DSH 原生轮次按钮和稳定的 `data-chat-*` 身份标识；如果当前切到“轨迹”等其他视图，请先回到“对话”。阅读恢复定位到最近阅读的问题，不保存页面的精确像素位置。

[English](README.en.md) · MIT

plugins.description: Branchpoint for DeepSeek Harness: fork the current chat into a fresh branch with a compact digest.
plugins.readme_text:
# Branchpoint

**Fork the conversation at a clean point.**

Branchpoint is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin that adds a fork button to the chat header. Click it and Branchpoint reads the current branch, distills what matters, and opens a fresh session with that digest already in the composer.

Long chats degrade. Compaction helps, but it also blurs the thread. Branchpoint gives you a clean branch that still knows where you were.

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint)](https://github.com/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint/releases/latest)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint)](LICENSE)

## What it does

- Adds a fork icon to `conversation.session.header.actions`, next to the branch title.
- Loads up to two older pages of session history when the prompt is outside the current window.
- Builds a compact digest:
  - the goal (last human prompt);
  - the latest assistant conclusion;
  - what was done in the last completed turn;
  - what is still open, including `in progress: <prompt>` when the latest turn has no answer yet;
  - errors from meaningful tools, changed files, versions, commands and key concepts.
- Opens a new session and puts the digest in the draft. It does **not** send automatically, so you can review it first.

## Example digest

```text
🌿 BRANCHPOINT — BRANCH SUMMARY
🎯 Goal: the handoff button does nothing

📌 LATEST CONCLUSION:
Fixed the silent no-op: the digest builder now keeps orphan assistant text and
pages older history before summarizing.

✅ DONE (1):
- silent no-op on empty digest → alert + fallback summary

⏳ OPEN (1):
- in progress: verify the button in a fresh session

📂 STATE:
· changed: lib/client.js
· files: lib/client.js, package.json
· run: npm test

(Summary, not a transcript: intermediate steps are omitted. Continue from this.)
```

## Install

Not on npm yet. Install the prebuilt tarball from the latest GitHub release:

```powershell
$tgz = "$env:TEMP\branchpoint.tgz"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint/releases/latest/download/branchpoint.tgz" -OutFile $tgz
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add ("file:" + ($tgz -replace '\\', '/'))
```

Or open **Settings → Plugins** in DSH and install the downloaded `.tgz` archive.

Fully quit and relaunch DSH. The desktop profile applies plugin composition at startup (it has no HMR).

## Use

1. Open an existing chat with at least one exchange.
2. Click the fork icon in the header.
3. Review the digest in the new session's composer and send it when ready.

The button is hidden on a blank session: DSH hides the header actions until the session has history.

## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is a minimal host half (`name`, empty `apply`).
- `lib/client.js`:
  - `inject = ['slots', 'uiWorkspace', 'sessions']`;
  - registers in `conversation.session.header.actions`;
  - reads `ctx.sessions.binding(sessionId).eventSource`;
  - `entriesToTurns` and `entriesToTools` parse messages and tool calls;
  - `loadOlderHistory` pages older history (max 2 pages, 7 s);
  - `buildDigest` produces the summary;
  - `ctx.uiWorkspace.startSession(undefined, { prompt: digest, clearPreviousDraft: true })` opens the new session.

No build step: `lib/client.js` is a ready ESM bundle in the `window.__ModuleLoader__` envelope.

## Limitations

- The digest is built from the **DSH session event log**. Reasoning and raw tool output are not summarized; only visible assistant text, tool errors, changed files and commands are used.
- The digest framing is English. Quoted conclusions stay in the language of the chat, since they are extracted verbatim.
- History is paged at most twice per click, so extremely long sessions may need a second click to reach the original prompt.
- If a branch has no assistant text and no tool results, Branchpoint shows an alert and does not open an empty session.

## Development

```powershell
node --check lib/client.js
npm pack
```

To load local changes, install the new `.tgz` (or `link:<folder>`) and restart DSH.

## License

MIT © 2026 TimRad1

plugins.description: 把「刷新页面 / 重启应用与 Host」写进 DSH 桌面端「应用」原生菜单的补丁插件：11 字节等长改写 app.asar，附完整 recipe 与独立脚本。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-menu

把「刷新页面 / 重启应用与 Host」**写进 DSH 桌面端左上角「应用」原生菜单**的补丁插件。
没有 UI、不往页面注入任何东西；它带的是补丁本身 + 完整思路，换台电脑也能照着做。

## 它做什么

DSH 桌面端「应用」下拉里的这两项，代码**本来就有**，只是被开发构建开关挡住：

```js
...development ? [ { role: "reload" }, { app.relaunch() ... } ] : []   // 安装版 development = false
```

插件把开关换成恒真的等价表达式，**两段都是 11 字节**，等长替换，不动 asar 任何偏移：

```diff
-		...development ? [
+		...!(0  === 1) ? [
```

再把这个文件在 asar 头里的 SHA256 `integrity` 等长同步，归档保持自洽。
完整推导：**[docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)**；给 AI 的照抄步骤：**[docs/RECIPE.md](docs/RECIPE.md)**。

## 给 AI 的用法（换台电脑也一样）

```text
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "status" })   # 只读：app.asar 在哪、补丁是否在位、哈希是否自洽
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "apply" })    # 写入补丁（幂等；已打过返回 already）
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "revert" })   # 还原
```

写完后**必须重启桌面端**（托盘 → 退出 → 重新打开）才会在菜单里看到，因为 `main.js` 只在主进程启动时加载。

`app.asar` 自动探测：工具参数 `asar` → 环境变量 `DSH_DESKTOP_ASAR` → 从可执行文件逐级向上找
`<dir>/resources/app.asar`。纯浏览器版返回 `not-desktop`。

## 安装

从 GitHub 装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:YOGEMOW/dsh-desktop-menu
```

或用插件管理器装本地目录：

```powershell
plugin_manager(install_bundle, target="<这个包的绝对路径>")
```

## 验证

- `node test/roundtrip.mjs`：复制一份真 `app.asar`，`revert → apply → apply(幂等)`，
  每步断言状态与哈希自洽、归档大小不变（`DSH_ASAR` 可指定路径）；
- `node test/status.mjs`：以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 跑桌面端 exe，验证 `original-fs` 回退和路径探测；
- `python docs/standalone/verify_patch.py "<app.asar 路径>"`：不依赖插件，直接复核当前安装。

## 注意

- 桌面端每次自动更新都会换掉 `app.asar`，补丁随之消失 —— 更新后重新 `apply` 一次即可（按内容定位，不依赖偏移）。
- 补丁改的是安装目录文件，需要写权限（装在 Program Files 时可能要管理员）。
- **为什么不做标题栏按钮**：没有可用插槽，而且插件无法真正重启（外部进程方案被安全软件/进程树问题挡住）。
  原生菜单的 `app.relaunch()` 才是可靠路径，见 DESIGN.md §4。

## 目录

```text
index.js                宿主半：注册 dsh_desktop_menu 工具
lib/desktop-menu.js     补丁/回滚/探测实现（含 original-fs 处理）
cordis.patch.yml        bundle patch
docs/DESIGN.md          设计说明与踩坑复盘
docs/RECIPE.md          给 AI 的照抄步骤
docs/standalone/        等价的独立 Python 脚本（apply / verify / inspect）
locale/{zh,en}.json     插件显示标题与描述
icon.svg                插件图标
test/                   回归与探测脚本
```

plugins.description: DSH 插件：点击新对话页工作区前的文件夹图标，一键切回默认工作区
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-default-workspace

[![test](https://github.com/Subwoofer91/dsh-default-workspace/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Subwoofer91/dsh-default-workspace/actions/workflows/test.yml)

在 DSH 新对话页的工作区选择器上增加一个快捷动作：**点工作区名称前的小文件夹图标，直接切回默认工作区**。不新增按钮，不改变原有菜单；点文字或右侧箭头仍然打开原来的工作区菜单。

仓库：<https://github.com/Subwoofer91/dsh-default-workspace>

| 切换前（其他工作区） | 点文件夹图标后（默认工作区） |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](docs/before.png) | ![after](docs/after.png) |

## 行为

- 只拦截新对话（hero）工作区胶囊最左侧的文件夹 SVG。
- 当前已经是默认工作区时不做任何事，单击仍然打开工作区菜单，方便切到其他工作区。
- 从其他工作区切回时，通过 `uiWorkspace.openWorkspace` 走原有导航流程，并尽量沿用内置选择逻辑迁移草稿和附件。
- 默认工作区通过持久化标题 `default-workspace` 或目录名识别；工作区被改名时，回退到 Host 的 `initializeDefault()` 返回的持久身份。
- 找不到默认工作区时完全不拦截，原有菜单行为不受影响。

## 安装

本插件是标准的 DSH bundle，包含 Host 空壳和 `client/client.js` 浏览器端实现。把它加入 Desktop profile 的依赖和 bundle 列表即可：

```yaml
# package.json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-default-workspace": "link:C:\\Users\\Subwoofer\\Documents\\deepseek-harness\\default-workspace\\dsh-default-workspace"
},
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": [
      "...",
      "dsh-default-workspace"
    ]
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录执行：

```powershell
pnpm install
```

Desktop 的 profile 会在 HMR 可用时自动重组；如果当前进程没有热重载，重启 DSH 后生效。

## 目录

- `client/client.js` — 浏览器端事件代理、默认工作区解析、导航与草稿迁移。
- `lib/index.js` — Host 空壳入口，使 bundle 可以被 Cordis 正常挂载。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle 的 Host 行声明。
- `test/behavior.test.mjs` — 不依赖浏览器的核心行为测试。

## 开发与测试

```powershell
node --test dsh-default-workspace/test/behavior.test.mjs
```

在这个环境里 Node 测试运行器（`node --test`）会再 spawn 子进程，可能被 DSH 沙箱以 `EPERM` 拒绝；直接运行测试文件即可：

```powershell
node dsh-default-workspace/test/behavior.test.mjs
```

## 已知限制

- 依赖内置 hero 工作区胶囊的 DOM 结构（一个按钮内含文件夹 SVG、标签、chevron）。如果上游重做该组件，需要同步调整 `folderIconOf`。
- 默认工作区被删除后，插件不会重新创建它；此时回退行为是保持原生菜单。

plugins.description: 在 DSH Desktop 上安装、配置和排查开屏动画插件的可复现流程
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Desktop 开屏动画安装指南

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/2073493463-crypto/dsh-splash-animation-setup)](https://github.com/2073493463-crypto/dsh-splash-animation-setup/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/2073493463-crypto/dsh-splash-animation-setup)](LICENSE)

在 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows）** 中安装、配置和排查社区插件
[`dsh-splash-animation`](https://github.com/KDDKBD/DeepSeek-splash-animation) 的可复现流程。

> 非官方文档。插件版权归 [KDDKBD](https://github.com/KDDKBD) 所有；本仓库只记录安装与配置方法，
> 不包含插件代码、插件素材或任何视频文件。

## 这是什么

`dsh-splash-animation` 会在 DSH 启动时播放一段视频，播完后渐隐进入主界面。
它不是 DSH 内置功能，而是通过插件的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 挂载到当前 profile 上。

本仓库解决三个问题：

1. **装到正确的 profile**：DSH 桌面版实际使用的是 `desktop` profile，不是 README 里常见的 `web`。
2. **没有 Git 也能装**：`github:` 简写依赖本机 `git`；没有 Git 时改用同一仓库的 GitHub tarball。
3. **配置和排查有据可查**：包含实测版本、配置项、重启方式、常见报错和回滚方法。

### 它怎么工作

1. `dsh plugin` 把插件包安装到当前 profile 的 `node_modules`；
2. 插件声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装器把它追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
3. DSH 启动时加载 bundle，Host 半在 `webserver/index-inject` 里注入启动样式和脚本；
4. 浏览器半在 `shell.overlay` 挂一层全屏视频，Host 通过带 Range 的本地路由流式提供视频；
5. 视频结束或用户跳过后，覆盖层渐隐并销毁，露出正常界面。

整个过程不修改 `app.asar`，所以 DSH 自动更新不会把它覆盖掉；卸载插件或清除配置即可恢复原状。

## 快速开始

也可以直接从 [Releases](https://github.com/2073493463-crypto/dsh-splash-animation-setup/releases) 下载 ZIP。

在 **普通 PowerShell** 中运行（不要通过 DSH 的沙箱终端运行）：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-DshSplash.ps1 `
  -VideoPath "D:\Videos\opening.mp4"
```

如果使用 PowerShell 7，把 `powershell` 换成 `pwsh` 即可。

脚本会：

- 找到 DSH Desktop 自带的 CLI 和实际使用的 `desktop` profile；
- 备份 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`pnpm-workspace.yaml`；
- 通过 DSH 自带的 `dsh plugin` 安装插件，并把它加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
- 写入开屏配置；
- 如果你传了 `-VideoPath`，同时写入视频路径；
- 提示你完全退出并重新打开 DSH。

不想用脚本，或者想理解每一步，请看
[docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)。

### 脚本参数

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `-VideoPath` | 视频路径；不传则只写配置，之后在设置页选择 |
| `-DryRun` | 只打印计划，不修改任何文件 |
| `-DshExe` | DSH 安装路径，默认从 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs` 查找 |
| `-DshHome` | DSH home，默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` |
| `-Profile` | profile 名，默认 `desktop` |
| `-ProfileDir` | 直接指定 profile 目录 |
| `-Spec` | 自定义安装 spec |
| `-UseGitSpec` | 强制使用 `github:` 简写 |
| `-SkipInstall` | 跳过安装，只写配置/视频 |
| `-SkipConfig` | 跳过 `cordis.patch.yml` 修改 |

> 插件 Host 代码会在 DSH 进程内执行。安装前请确认来源可信；本仓库不审计插件代码。

## 已验证环境

| 项目 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows 10/11 x64 |
| DSH Desktop | `0.2.1-rc.2` |
| Electron | `44.7.0` |
| 内置 Node | `24.21.0` |
| 插件 | `dsh-splash-animation@0.4.5` |
| 实测日期 | 2026-10 |

插件声明 `engines.node >= 20`，没有额外的 DSH peer 依赖；它使用的
`webserver/index-inject`、`webServer.register`、`settings.plugins.tab` 和
`shell.overlay` 在实测版本中均存在。更完整的检查过程见
[docs/COMPATIBILITY.zh-CN.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.zh-CN.md)。

## 安装后的效果

本指南默认写入以下配置：

| 字段 | 值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `fit` | `contain` | 完整显示视频，保留画面边缘，可能留黑边 |
| `playbackRate` | `1` | 原速播放 |
| `duration` | `0` | 播放到视频结束，不按固定时长截断 |
| `fadeOutMs` | `600` | 播完后 600ms 渐隐进入主界面 |
| `skip` | `button` | 右下角显示“跳过”按钮 |
| `muted` | `false` | 先尝试带声音播放 |
| `volume` | `0.6` | 音量 60% |

`src` 由你选择的视频决定。如果暂时不选，脚本会写入空字符串 `src: ""`，
这样插件不会播放自带的示例视频。

## 设置视频

安装并重启一次后，打开：

**设置 → 插件 → 开屏动画 → 选择文件…**

选中视频，点 **保存**。保存后会写入：

```text
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-splash-animation\config.json
```

设置页显示“下次启动播放”后，完全退出 DSH 再打开即可看到效果。

> 注意：左侧栏的“插件”是插件管理页；视频设置入口在“设置 → 插件”下的“开屏动画”标签页。

## 重启方法

**只关闭主窗口可能只是隐藏到系统托盘，不会重启 Host。**

1. 右键系统托盘里的 DeepSeek Harness 图标；
2. 选择 **退出**；
3. 等托盘图标消失；
4. 从开始菜单或桌面快捷方式重新打开。

插件的 Host 半在 DSH 启动时加载，所以安装或升级插件后必须完整重启；
只刷新页面不够。

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 先检查 |
|---|---|
| `git: not found` / `spawn git ENOENT` | 本机没有 Git；改用 tarball 安装，见安装文档 |
| `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively` | 不要用 npm 全局安装的 `dsh`；用桌面版自带的 CLI |
| `EPERM ... package.json.lock` | 不要在 DSH 沙箱内执行；换普通 PowerShell，避免并发安装 |
| 重启后没有动画 | `src` 是否为空、视频是否还存在、插件是否在 `bundles` 中 |
| 设置页没有“开屏动画” | 插件 Host 没加载；检查 profile 和重启方式 |
| 有画面没声音 | Chromium 自动播放策略；插件会自动静音重试 |
| 一直黑屏约 10 秒 | 插件客户端没加载；看 DSH 日志并重装 |
| 视频黑屏但能跳过 | 编码不被支持；优先 H.264/AAC 的 MP4，或 VP9 的 WebM |

完整排查见 [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md)。

## 卸载与回滚

优先级从高到低：

1. **设置 → 插件 → 开屏动画 → 清除**：只关闭开屏，不卸载插件。
2. **设置 → 插件**：禁用或移除插件。
3. 恢复安装前的备份文件（脚本会在临时目录打印备份路径）。
4. 手动从 profile 的 `package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 中移除插件。

不要只删除 `node_modules`：profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 还引用它时，
DSH 启动会报模块缺失。

## 仓库结构

```text
.
├─ README.md
├─ docs/
│  ├─ INSTALL.zh-CN.md          # 从零安装，含 Git / 无 Git 两条路径
│  ├─ COMPATIBILITY.zh-CN.md    # 版本检查与 API 依据
│  ├─ TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md  # 常见报错与回滚
```

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-pm

Agent PM 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件版本。

它把 `agent-pm` 技能注册到 DSH 的 `ctx.skills` 宿主层，让每个 agent preset 都能在技能目录里看到并使用它。

## 这是什么

Agent PM 是一个产品经理视角的 agent 项目审查工具。它不审查实现代码，而是审查“写的人以为说清楚了但其实没有”的设计问题：

- Claude Code `SKILL.md` / DSH `<name>/SKILL.md`
- `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` / 指令文件
- MCP Server
- DSH 插件（技能包 / 工具 / 事件）

核心约束是 Iron Law：`NO ISSUE REPORT WITHOUT EXECUTION VERIFICATION FIRST`。

## 安装

### 本地目录

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-agent-pm
```

### npm（发布后）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-pm
```

### GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lbyxunxunnini/dsh-agent-pm
```

建议锁定标签，避免后续提交改变实际运行内容：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:lbyxunxunnini/dsh-agent-pm#v0.1.0'
```

仓库地址：https://github.com/lbyxunxunnini/dsh-agent-pm

安装后启动对应的 profile：

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

## 使用

在 DSH 会话里直接说：

```text
用 agent-pm 审查这个项目
```

也可以在技能目录中选择 `agent-pm`。如果宿主支持斜杠命令，可以使用：

```text
/agent-pm [path] [--score]
```

常用组合：

- `审查并评分` → 审查后进入产品评分
- `只评分` → 直接进入产品评审
- `修复后评分` → 先修复已确认问题，再评分
- `创建新 skill` → 进入需求澄清模式

## 审查模式

| 模式 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| A：审阅 | 按 checklist 做技术审查，输出问题报告 |
| B：修复 | 修复已确认的 accepted 问题 |
| C：新 Skill 澄清 | 在生成 SKILL.md 之前闭环目标、边界、流程和验收 |
| D：产品评审 / 评分 | 三方评估、维度评分、目标治理分析 |

DSH 插件额外读取 `skills/agent-pm/references/dsh-plugin-review.md`，检查插件清单、`ctx` 注册、资源路径和版本兼容声明。

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-agent-pm/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle 清单
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 插入技能提供者
├── lib/index.js          # ctx.skills 提供者
├── skills/agent-pm/
│   ├── SKILL.md
│   └── references/       # 审查清单、模式、示例、DSH 专项清单
└── scripts/verify.mjs    # 静态 + provider 级检查
```

## 版本

| 层 | 版本 |
|----|------|
| 插件 | `0.1.0` |
| 技能内容 | 基于 `agent-pm` `3.0.11` |

插件面向 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 编写。DSH 目前是开发者预览，后续版本可能有破坏性变更；安装前请先核对版本。

> 当前状态：已在隔离的 `DSH_HOME` 中用 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 完成安装、技能发现、正文加载和卸载验证；未在 Web UI 中做人工触发验证。首次实测步骤见下节。

## 权限与外部服务

- 不发起网络请求。
- 不读取环境变量、凭据或工作区之外的业务文件。
- 运行时只读取包内 `skills/agent-pm/` 下的 `SKILL.md` 和 `references/`。
- 安装阶段没有 `prepare` 构建脚本；插件代码在 DSH 启动加载时执行。
- 代码只使用 Node 内置模块，要求 Node.js >= 18。macOS 已实测；Windows / Linux 未实测。

## 可见的验证输出

在隔离 `DSH_HOME` 中通过 `ctx.skills` 探针得到的真实输出：

```text
[probe] skills=agent-pm,agently-mail,task-driver
[probe] summary={"name":"agent-pm","descriptionLength":272,"provider":"dsh-agent-pm"}
[probe] definition={"name":"agent-pm","contentLength":8134,"resourceBase":"directory"}
```

安装命令实测：

```text
+ dsh-agent-pm github:lbyxunxunnini/dsh-agent-pm#v0.1.0
Done in 10.9s
```

## 验证

```sh
npm run verify
```

该命令不会启动 DSH，而是用最小 `ctx` stub 调用插件注册的 provider，验证：

- 插件只注册一个 provider
- `skills/agent-pm/SKILL.md` 能被发现
- 多行 `description: |-` 能被正确解析
- `get()` 能加载正文并返回目录型 `resourceBase`

真实 DSH 验证建议使用隔离的 `DSH_HOME`：

```sh
export DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-agent-pm-test
dsh plugin --profile test add /absolute/path/to/dsh-agent-pm
dsh --profile test --dump-config
dsh --profile test
```

确认技能目录出现 `agent-pm` 后，再卸载并确认技能消失。

## License

MIT

# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider

Ollama Cloud LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- Ollama Cloud provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers one native LLM route, `ollama-cloud`, served by `https://ollama.com`, with two wire protocols: | Transport | Endpoint | When | |---|---|---| | `native` (default) | `POST /api/chat` | thinking, tool calls, usage counters | | `openai-chat` | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI-compatible deployments and fallback | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / launch env"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-ollama-cloud-provider"] Router{"Route: ollama-cloud"} Pool["Account pool
rotation, cooldowns, sticky"] Catalog["Live catalog
/v1/models + /api/tags"] Usage["Balance & usage
/api/balance + /api/usage"] subgraph Transports["Wire protocols"] T1["Native /api/chat (NDJSON)"] T2["OpenAI /v1/chat/completions (SSE)"] end end subgraph Ollama["Ollama Cloud"] Chat["ollama.com/api/chat"] OpenAI["ollama.com/v1/chat/completions"] Billing["/api/balance, /api/usage"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router --> Pool Pool --> Transports T1 --> Chat T2 --> OpenAI Catalog --> Router Usage --> Billing ``` ## Features - **Two wire transports** chosen per model: the native Ollama API (NDJSON) and the OpenAI-compatible gateway (SSE). - **Text, thinking, tool calls, images, usage and finish reasons** on both transports. - **Live catalog** from `GET /v1/models`, enriched with capability flags from `GET /api/tags`. - **Accurate limits** for the dsh picker: context window, input modalities, reasoning levels and their default, tool support, and API visibility. - **Balance and usage** from the official `/api/balance` and `/api/usage` endpoints: included credits, purchased credits, 24-hour / 7-day / 30-day spend, and spend by model. - **Multi-account rotation** before any content is streamed: 401/403/429 and quota rejections mark a key and retry with the next one. Cooldowns persist across restarts. - **Sticky accounts** per conversation, plus model → account glob rules. - **Price estimates** from the published Ollama pricing table, including off-peak rates, with per-model overrides. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → Ollama Cloud**: key, balance, accounts, rules, model allowlist, per-model transport, connection settings. - **Sidebar quota card** (off by default, and it does not poll `/state` while disabled): a ring with the highest used window and rows with remaining credits or legacy windows; an optional `planLabel` is shown next to the provider name. - **Center quota panel**: spend windows, spend by model, accounts, routing trace, usage analytics and a request heatmap. - **`/ollama` command** for status, usage, balance, accounts, models, rules and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for terminal profiles. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → Ollama Cloud. ## Install Build and pack first: ```bash npm install npm run build npm pack ``` Install the published package: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider@0.1.7 # DSH Desktop: dsh plugin --profile desktop add @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider@0.1.7 ``` Or install the packed tarball into a profile: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-ollama-cloud-provider-0.1.7.tgz # DSH Desktop: dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-ollama-cloud-provider-0.1.7.tgz ``` Restart dsh (or DSH Desktop), then pick **Ollama Cloud** in the model picker. > **Use the tarball, not the directory.** On dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 the Desktop CLI aliases a local > directory passed to `dsh plugin add` and overwrites the target's `package.json`. ## Configure ```yaml - id: llm-ollama-cloud name: "@goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider" config: apiKeyEnv: OLLAMA_API_KEY # default # apiKey: ... # composition only, never commit transport: native # native | openai-chat requestTimeoutMs: 300000 streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000 visibleModels: [] modelTransports: {} # contextWindowOverrides: { "model-id": 131072 } # maxOutputTokens: 32768 accounts: - label: Work apiKeyEnv: OLLAMA_API_KEY_2 activeAccount: '' # label or credential name to pin stickySession: true showSidebarQuota: false planLabel: '' # optional, e.g. PRO ``` Every field except `apiKey` is volatile and appears in dsh settings. ### Keys 1. `config.apiKey` (composition only, `role('secret')`). 2. The dsh credential seam under `apiKeyEnv` (default `OLLAMA_API_KEY`). 3. The launch environment (process, project `.env`, `$DSH_HOME/.env`). Create a key at . Keys do not expire; `x-api-key` is **not** accepted, only `Authorization: Bearer`. ### Accounts and rotation Add a second account in **Settings → Ollama Cloud → Accounts**: give it a name and a credential reference (for example `OLLAMA_API_KEY_2`), paste its key, then Save. The default account always serves first unless `activeAccount` pins another one. Rotation happens **before any content is streamed**. When the serving key is rejected with an invalid credential, a rate limit or an exhausted quota, the adapter marks that key and retries the same request with the next usable account. A request that already started streaming is not replayed. Cooldowns are stored in `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ollama/cooldowns.json` keyed by a SHA-256 fingerprint — raw keys are never written. ### Model → account rules Pin a model to a preferred account with a glob. The first matching rule wins; `*` and `?` are supported and matching is case-insensitive. Other accounts remain fallbacks. ```yaml modelAccountRules: - pattern: "*flash*" account: "Work" ``` ## Balance and usage The plugin uses the documented cloud endpoints: - `GET /api/balance` → `included.balance_usd` / `included.allowance_usd` / `included.period` and `purchased.balance_usd`. Legacy accounts return `included.session.remaining_percent` and `included.weekly.remaining_percent`; both formats are displayed. - `GET /api/usage?range=24h|7d|30d&group_by=model` → totals and per-model groups with request count, USD, input, cached input and output tokens. `/api/usage` is limited to **10 requests per minute per user**, so the reader caches each range (balance 60 s, usage 120 s, failures 30 s) and never polls in the background. Quota failures are fail-open: chat never depends on them. ## Settings page Open **Settings → Ollama Cloud**: - **Key** — status, paste a key, clear it, run **Test connection** against a chosen model. plugins.description: ChatGPT Web model provider for DeepSeek Harness — spends the ChatGPT web quota, not Codex quota.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-chatgpt-web

[English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文)

---

## English

A **ChatGPT Web model provider for DeepSeek Harness**. It adds a model route named `chatgpt-web` and answers model calls by driving **your own logged-in chatgpt.com session** in a local Chrome — so inference is paid from the **ChatGPT web quota**, not from the OpenAI API and **not from your Codex quota**.

- ✅ Spends the ChatGPT **web** plan quota (the same pool you use chatting on chatgpt.com)
- ❌ Does **not** use `~/.codex/auth.json`, Codex OAuth, or Codex quota
- ❌ No API key, no proxy server, no account sharing

### Why a browser and not plain HTTP

ChatGPT's web backend (`/backend-api/f/conversation`) requires a per-request Sentinel/PoW token plus Cloudflare clearance. Those cannot be forged reliably outside a real browser session. So this plugin drives a real Chromium-family browser over the DevTools Protocol (zero dependencies — Node's built-in `WebSocket`) and reads the answer from the page.

### Requirements

- A Chromium-family browser (Chrome, Edge, Chromium)
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x
- A ChatGPT account, signed in **once** inside the plugin's own browser profile

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-llm-chatgpt-web
# or, inside the Harness: plugin_manager install_bundle <absolute path>
```

The bundle inserts one row:

```yaml
- id: llm-chatgpt-web
  name: dsh-llm-chatgpt-web
  config: {}
```

### First run: sign in once

1. Pick **ChatGPT Web** in the model selector and send anything.
2. The plugin opens a dedicated Chrome window on the ChatGPT login page and reports that web sign-in is still missing.
3. Sign in inside **that** window. The session is stored in the plugin's own profile (`~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/chrome-profile`), not in your daily browser.
4. Send again.

The dedicated browser starts on demand **in the background** (macOS: `open -g -j`) and is **re-launched automatically** if you close it, without stealing focus from the window you are working in. The one exception is a sign-in prompt: the plugin then moves the window on screen and activates it, because you cannot type into a login page you cannot see.

### Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `chatgpt-web` | Route id used by the model selector |
| `displayName` | `ChatGPT 网页版` | Label shown in DSH |
| `transport` | `web` | `fake` = offline self-test stream |
| `chromePath` | Google Chrome (macOS path) | Browser executable |
| `userDataDir` | `~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/chrome-profile` | Dedicated browser profile (login lives here) |
| `debuggingPort` | `9333` | CDP port for the dedicated browser |
| `windowMode` | `hidden` | `visible` / `hidden` (window moved off-screen, launched in the background) / `headless` (blocked by ChatGPT — not recommended) |
| `temporaryChat` | `true` | Use a temporary chat (not written to your ChatGPT history) |
| `conversationMode` | `continue` | `continue` = keep one temporary chat per DSH session and send only deltas; `fresh` = new chat each call |
| `reasoningEffort` | `high` | Aligns the web "thinking effort" slider before every call (`low` / `medium` / `high`) |
| `webModel` | empty | Optionally force a web model such as `GPT-6`; empty keeps the page's current pick |
| `maxPromptChars` | `60000` | Prompt budget in characters |
| `emulateTools` | `true` | Emulate function calling with a text protocol (see below) |
| `responseTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Max wait for one reply |

### Tool calling

The web UI has no function-calling API. The plugin asks the model for a fenced JSON block:

```json
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "ls"}}
```

and translates it into a real DSH `tool-call`; the tool result is pasted back into the next turn. The prompt explicitly forbids the model's own container/code-interpreter from being used, and a reply that claims it ran something without a tool call is rejected and retried.

### Known limitations

- **One conversation per DSH session**: each session gets its own browser tab, holding one temporary chat for its whole lifetime. Later calls continue in that tab and send only the delta (new user turns / tool results), so the web page itself keeps the context. Different sessions are isolated from each other. Set `conversationMode: fresh` to always start over.
- **Serial**: one browser tab, so model calls queue.
- **Every turn re-sends the task + tools + recent history** (temporary chat means no server-side carry-over). Each step takes roughly 10–40 s with `reasoningEffort=high`.
- **Text only**: images are not forwarded.
- **Depends on chatgpt.com DOM**: when OpenAI ships a redesign, selectors may need updating. Failures save a screenshot to `~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/logs/screenshots/`.
- **Not a security boundary**: the plugin runs with your local user permissions and your own ChatGPT session. Review the source before installing.

### Troubleshooting

- Logs: `~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/logs/chatgpt-web-YYYY-MM-DD.log`
- Last prompt sent: `~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/logs/debug/last-prompt.txt`
- Unit tests: `node scripts/test-transcript.mjs`

### License

MIT.

---

## 简体中文

把 **ChatGPT 网页端** 接成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由（路由 id：`chatgpt-web`）。选它之后，DSH 每次模型调用都会用**你本机已登录的 chatgpt.com 会话**、在本地 Chrome 里完成，因此消耗的是 **ChatGPT 网页额度**——不是 OpenAI API 额度，**也不是 Codex 额度**。

- ✅ 花 ChatGPT 网页版套餐额度（和在网页上聊天同一个池子）
- ❌ 不读 `~/.codex/auth.json`、不走 Codex OAuth、不花 Codex 额度
- ❌ 不需要 API key、不需要中转服务器、不共享账号

### 为什么必须是浏览器

ChatGPT 网页后端（`/backend-api/f/conversation`）要逐请求变化的 Sentinel/PoW 令牌和 Cloudflare 放行，离开真实浏览器会话伪造不出来。所以插件用 DevTools 协议驱动一个真实 Chromium 浏览器（零依赖，只用 Node 内置 `WebSocket`），从页面里读回复。

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-llm-chatgpt-web
```

### 首次使用：登录一次

1. 模型选择器里选 **ChatGPT 网页版**，随便发一句。
2. 插件会打开一个专用 Chrome 窗口，停在登录页。
3. 在**那个**窗口里登录（账号密码或 Google 都行），登录态存在插件自己的 profile 里。
4. 回来再发一次。

浏览器是**后台按需启动**的（macOS 用 `open -g -j`），不会抢你正在用的窗口的焦点；你手动关掉它也会自动重新拉起。唯一例外是**需要登录**：这时插件会把窗口挪回屏幕内并激活，否则你看不见登录页。

### 已知限制

- **每个 DSH 会话一条临时对话**：会话独占一个标签页，整个会话期间都用这一条对话；后续只发增量（新的用户消息 / 工具结果），上下文由网页端维护，不同会话互不串味。`conversationMode: fresh` 可恢复每轮新建。
- 单浏览器标签，调用串行排队。
- 每轮都要重新贴「任务 + 工具 + 最近记录」（用临时对话，不污染历史），`reasoningEffort=high` 时一步通常 10–40 秒。
- 暂不支持图片输入。
- 依赖 chatgpt.com 的 DOM，改版可能要跟进选择器；失败会自动截图到 `~/.dsh/chatgpt-web/logs/screenshots/`。
- 不是安全沙箱：插件用你的本地用户权限和你自己的 ChatGPT 会话，装前请读源码。

### 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: 深鲸企业审计套件：审批台账 + 决策复盘 + 审计报告 + 定时复盘，一个授权全部可用（商业授权，14 天试用）
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-enterprise-suite

给需要「审批留痕 + 事后复盘 + 可导出审计材料」的团队：一个授权，四个能力。

**关键词**：企业审计 · 审批台账 · 决策复盘 · 审计报告导出 · 合规留痕 · DeepSeek Harness 插件

## 四个能力

| # | 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| ① | 审批台账 | 由 `@deepwhale-cn/dsh-approval-ledger` 采集，写 `ledger.jsonl` |
| ② | 决策复盘 | 关键决策、被拒原因、待复审项、复盘问题清单 |
| ③ | 审计报告导出 | `deepwhale.enterprise-audit/v1` JSON 或 Markdown，带授权与试用标记 |
| ④ | 定时复盘 | 示例 cron，交付物是文件——报告落盘，不用人来点 |

## 授权

- 授权码形如 `DWH-ENT-XXXX-XXXX`，可放插件 config、环境变量 `DSH_ENTERPRISE_LICENSE`，或台账目录下的 `license.txt`。
- **未授权 = 14 天试用**：只显示最近 20 条、导出带 trial 标记；**审批记录本身不锁**——试用期也不耽误你看自己的数据。
- 企业版说明：https://deepwhale.org.cn/enterprise.html

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-enterprise-suite
```

## 用法

装好后直接对 agent 说：

> 用 enterprise_status 看下授权和台账概况，再用 enterprise_review 复盘最近这批审批。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `enterprise_status` | 授权状态（企业 / 试用、剩余天数）+ 审批统计 |
| `enterprise_review` | 决策复盘报告（可选 `since` / `limit`） |

宿主支持 webServer 时还会注册一个本地面板：

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `/enterprise` | 企业审计面板（HTML） |
| `/enterprise/data` | 面板数据 JSON |
| `/enterprise/export?format=json` | 审计材料导出（`deepwhale.enterprise-audit/v1`） |
| `/enterprise/export?format=md` | 复盘报告 Markdown |

## 边界（重要）

- **它是交付辅助，不是法律意见**：导出材料只把系统里的事实整理成文档，是否提交、怎么解读由使用方及其法务判断。
- 试用限制只在**展示条数与导出标记**上，不改台账数据、不影响审批本身。
- 与单插件的关系：台账、复盘也可以单独装（`dsh-approval-ledger`、`dsh-decision-review`）；套件的价值是**一处授权 + 一键导出**。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

plugins.description: Import sessions from a local Hermes Agent into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hermes-session

Import sessions from a local [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/InternScience/Hermes-Agent) into the
current [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) conversation as bounded,
untrusted background context.

Hermes Agent is a **separate agent** running on the same machine, with its own session store
(`~/.hermes/state.db`, one SQLite database per profile). This plugin reads that store **read-only** and
offers three ways in:

| Entry point | Shape | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `＋ Hermes` | Composer button | Opens a searchable list of sessions across every profile; picking one inserts a reference chip into your draft |
| `hermes_sessions_list` | Model tool | Lists sessions (title / working directory / message count / last activity) across all profiles, sorted by recency |
| `hermes_session_import` | Model tool | Imports one session by id (a unique prefix is enough) |

Imported content always carries a fixed "untrusted background" notice: the model may cite facts from it
but must not follow instructions, permission claims, or tool requests found inside it. The same rule the
harness applies to its own `@`-mentioned session references.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.0-rc.1`
- Python 3.8+ on `PATH` (standard library only — the plugin shells out to a small `sqlite3` helper)
- A local Hermes Agent installation whose session store is readable

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hermes-session
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-hermes-session
```

## Configuration

The plugin row takes a `config` mapping (see `cordis.patch.yml`). All fields are optional:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dbPath` | `""` | Path to a specific `state.db`. Empty scans every profile under `~/.hermes/profiles/` plus the default database |
| `pythonPath` | `""` | Python interpreter to run the helper with. Empty uses `$HERMES_PYTHON`, then `python3` |
| `maxChars` | `60000` | Default character budget for one import |
| `maxCharsHard` | `160000` | Upper bound a caller may request |
| `maxMessages` | `300` | Default number of messages to carry over |

## How it works

```
Hermes Agent                     this plugin                     DSH
────────────                     ───────────                     ───
~/.hermes/state.db  ──read-only──▶ scripts/hermes_read.py  ──▶  Hermes session
~/.hermes/profiles/*/state.db             │
                                           │ sessions table (metadata)
                                           │ messages table (conversation)
                                           ▼
                                        src/render.js  →  untrusted-background text block
                                                             │
src/routes.js  ◀──HTTP── client.js ─────┘                    ▼
  GET  /api/hermes.sessions                            current conversation
                                          (one collapsed row)
```

- **Read-only by construction.** The helper opens SQLite with `mode=ro`; it never writes to Hermes's
  store, and it never starts the Hermes process (that one self-checks on startup and fails on read-only
  filesystems).
- **Multi-profile aware.** Hermes keeps one database per profile. The default database holds only the
  `default` profile, so reading it alone would miss every other profile's sessions. The plugin scans all
  of them and labels each result with its source profile.
- **Bounded.** Message bodies are clipped, older messages are dropped first, and the truncation is
  reported in the injected header rather than hidden.

## How the pick reaches the model

Picking a session writes a **Markdown mention into your draft** — exactly like the harness's own
`@`-mentioned session references:

```
＋ Hermes → pick a session
          → the draft gets a blue reference chip:
            @[Session title](dsh-hermes:<base64url>)
          → you type your request and send
          → agent/pre-step resolves the mention
          → reads the Hermes session, renders it as a form:'recall' context message
          → appended after your message → the model sees both in one turn
```

The chip is inserted along the same path the native `@` reference uses: bail
`slash/input-insert-reference` on the session scope, where conversation.input's
listener hands it to `shell.insertReference`. It therefore renders exactly like the
harness's own `@`-mentioned session references — blue, removable, and carrying the
mention in its text.

Note on the public API: the `inputActions` face a plugin receives exposes only
`captureInsertion` / `insertText` / `setDraft` / `addAttachments` /
`removeAttachment` / `pruneAttachments` / `submit` — there is **no chip-insertion
method** (`insertReference` lives inside the SessionInputShell class). The session
scope is reachable via `sessions.using(sessionId, ..., ref => ref.binding.ctx)`. The picker
closes when you click elsewhere or press Escape, and the button is plain text, matching
the official "+skills" button.

Two consequences worth knowing:

- **Nothing is attached until you send.** Picking a session never wakes the agent — you choose the
  material first, describe what you want afterwards, and both travel in one message.
- **The mention stays editable.** It is ordinary draft text: you can reword it, delete it, or add a
  second session, and the model only sees the sessions you actually sent.

The mention is parsed by the `agent/pre-step` hook, which reads the session, renders it as a collapsed
context row (`form: 'recall'`), and appends it after your message.

## The injected context

The snapshot is attached as a **collapsed context row**, not as an expanded message bubble:
the conversation shows the source session's title, and expanding it reveals the transcript in a bounded,
scrollable code-style body. This mirrors how the harness renders its own session references.

## Development

```sh
node --check src/*.js && node --check client.js   # syntax
node selftest/run.mjs && node selftest/clientid.mjs
```

The self-tests run against a real Hermes store (read-only) and assert the plugin's invariants: the
client module id matches the package name, the HTTP routes are registered with the right methods, the
the mention is parsed and the attached message carries the `form: 'recall'` source shape the chat
renderer expects.

## Privacy

The plugin only reads. It never writes to the Hermes store, never sends session content anywhere, and
runs entirely on the machine where Hermes already lives.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Lightweight notes & todo panel plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: work/personal todo columns, five autosaving memo windows, drag-to-reorder, inline editing, local JSON storage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-memo（备忘）

A lightweight **notes & todo** panel plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI. Everything is stored locally on your machine — no account, no sync, no network calls.

DSH Web UI 的「备忘」插件：侧栏一个入口，面板顶部一个 sheet 页签切换 **待办 / 备忘**。数据全部保存在本机，可直接阅读和备份。

## 功能

- **待办分栏**：左「工作」、右「个人」，各自输入后回车添加。
- **已完成单独成区**：每栏下半部分是「已完成」，新完成的排最上面、显示完成时间，灰色文字不划线，一眼能看清。
- **拖拽排序**：按住待办行拖动即可在栏内调整顺序（上半区/下半区各自排序），顺序持久化；拖动时有插入指示线。
- **行内编辑**：直接点待办文字就地修改，回车或点别处保存，`Esc` 取消；没有多余的编辑按钮。
- **多窗口备忘**：左侧 2×2 四个窗口 + 右侧一个完整大窗口，可同时记多处内容。
- **自动保存**：备忘边写边存（600ms 防抖），失焦 / 切页签 / 关页面立即落盘；标题旁显示「保存中… / 已自动保存 · 时间」。
- **跟随 DSH 主题**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，浅色/深色自动适配；中英文文案走 `ctx.locale`。
- **本地优先**：单文件 JSON 存储，串行写入 + 原子替换，文件损坏自动备份。

## 安装

插件是纯 JavaScript 包，无构建步骤、无第三方运行时依赖。

### 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 里让助手执行 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，目标填：

```
github:nin2c/dsh-plugin-memo
```

或在终端（选择合适的 profile，`desktop` / `web`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nin2c/dsh-plugin-memo
```

然后重启 DSH（或让插件经理热加载）。安装后在左侧栏会出现「备忘」图标。

### 方式二：从本地目录安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nin2c/dsh-plugin-memo.git
```

再用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向该目录（本地目录会以 `link:` 方式安装）。

### 方式三：手动放进 profile

把本包加入 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，由 DSH 的 bundle 层加载。

## 使用

- 打开：左侧栏（Plugins / Schedules 同一条）点 📝 图标。
- 待办：输入 → 回车添加；勾选完成；点文字改内容；拖拽换位置；每栏可单独「清空已完成」。
- 备忘：直接在五个窗口里写，自动保存。
- 数据：`$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/notes-todo/data.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/plugin-data/notes-todo/data.json`）。

> 数据目录名 `notes-todo` 是历史命名，包名已改为 `dsh-plugin-memo`，升级不会丢数据。

## 数据格式

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "todos": [
    { "id": "t_…", "text": "…", "done": false, "category": "work", "createdAt": "…", "doneAt": null }
  ],
  "memos": {
    "topLeft": "…", "topRight": "…", "bottomLeft": "…", "bottomRight": "…", "main": "…"
  },
  "updatedAt": "…"
}
```

`category` 为 `work` 或 `personal`；数组顺序即待办显示顺序。旧版数据（v1 的 `notes` 列表、无分类待办、三窗口备忘）会在读取时自动迁移。

## 宿主 API

插件在宿主注册同源 HTTP 路由 `/notes-todo`（由 `webServer` 提供）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/notes-todo/api/ping` | 版本、数据文件路径、计数 |
| GET | `/notes-todo/api/state` | `{ ok, todos, memos, updatedAt }` |
| POST | `/notes-todo/api/mutate` | 一次原子操作，返回完整新状态 |
| POST | `/notes-todo/api/client-log` | 面板崩溃上报 |

`mutate` 的 `op`：`todo.add` / `todo.update` / `todo.toggle` / `todo.move` / `todo.delete` / `todo.clearCompleted` / `memo.set`。操作只在插件自己的 Host 与页面之间使用。

## 兼容性

- 面向 DSH 的 Web UI（Desktop / Web profile），使用官方插槽（`sidebar.panellist`、`main`）与 `webServer` 路由，不依赖 DSH 内部私有包。
- 在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（Desktop profile）上开发与验证。
- 客户端只用 `require('react')` 与主题 token；宿主只使用 Node 内置模块，因此不需要构建。

## 开发

```bash
# 语法检查
npm run check
```

- `index.js` — 宿主半：`webServer` 前缀路由 + JSON 存储 + 数据迁移。
- `client.js` — Web 半：插槽注册、React 面板、拖拽与行内编辑、自动保存。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 插入 `memo` 插件行。
- `locale/{en,zh}.json`、`icon.svg` — 插件管理页的标题、描述与图标。

源码是手写的可读 JavaScript，没有压缩产物；改完重新加载插件（或重启 DSH）即可生效。

## 隐私

- 不联网、不收集数据、无遥测。
- 所有内容只写本机 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/notes-todo/` 下的 JSON 文件。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 nin2c

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enter-swap

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：**输入框 Enter = 换行，Shift+Enter = 发送**。
极简、零依赖、无设置页、行为固定，装完即用。

## 功能

- **Enter → 换行；Shift+Enter → 发送**
- **输入框工具栏（模型选择器左侧）常驻键位胶囊：〔Shift+Enter 发送消息〕〔Enter 换行〕**（0.1.2 起，0.1.4 起改挂引擎原生插槽，不遮挡正文）
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter（原生加速投递）、Alt+Enter 保持原生
- 中文输入法组词过程不拦截（IME 组帧放行）
- 斜杠命令 / @提及候选菜单打开时，Enter 照常选中菜单项
- 无设置页、无网络请求、无文件读写、零 npm 依赖

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xuqiuba888/dsh-enter-swap
```

其他 profile 同理（`--profile <名>`）。装完重启 dsh（Desktop/NEXT 重启应用），
浏览器/界面硬刷新（Ctrl+Shift+R）生效。

### 卸载与更新

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-enter-swap   # 更新到最新
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-enter-swap   # 卸载，刷新即回原生
```

## 文件结构

```
├── package.json         # dsh.client（Web 插件）+ dsh.bundle（profile patch）声明
├── cordis.patch.yml     # bundle patch：插入插件行
├── pnpm-lock.yaml       # 依赖快照（零依赖，仅为 link 安装惯例）
├── lib/
│   └── index.js         # Host 半部：空实现（本插件不需要宿主行为）
└── client/
    └── client.js        # Client 半部：捕获阶段按键互换
```

## 实现要点

- 在 document 捕获阶段监听 `keydown`，仅当目标位于输入框
  （`[data-composer-input="true"]`）内才处理
- 手势判定：Alt/Ctrl/Cmd 一律放行；`isComposing` / keyCode 229 放行；
  检测到挂载在 `<body>` 直下且**可见**的 portal 菜单（`role="menu" /
  "listbox"`，即斜杠/@候选弹层）时放行，Enter 照常选中菜单项——隐藏的
  残留弹层（如新开会话后的工作区选择器）不算菜单开着
- 命中时 `preventDefault + stopPropagation`，再把互换后的手势以合成
  KeyboardEvent 派发回引擎——**语义（发送/排队/换行）仍由引擎自己决定**
- Client bundle 为纯 JS，`__ModuleLoader__` 工厂格式，无需构建步骤

## 兼容性

DSH 0.2.x（在 0.2.1-rc.2 web 界面上开发并验证）。不使用任何引擎版本特定的
内部 API。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Snipaste-style screenshot annotation for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-snip DeepSeek Harness 的轻量截图标注插件。 交互方式和 Snipaste 一致：**按 F1（或点剪刀）→ 整个屏幕定格压暗 → 鼠标框选 → 选区下方工具条上画红框 / 写文字 → 完成**。 浮层是宿主侧拉起的**系统级全屏窗口**，不是页面里的图片，所以能截桌面端以外的任何东西，页面里也不会出现任何截图预览。 ![截图状态：整屏压暗、红色方框与文字标注、选区下方工具条](docs/overlay.png)

截图状态：整屏压暗 → 框选 → 红框 + 文字（滚轮调字号）→ 工具条 Box / Text / Size / Done / Cancel

> **English**: A Snipaste-style screenshot tool for DeepSeek Harness. Press `F1` anywhere (a real Windows global hotkey) and the whole screen freezes and dims; drag a region, then annotate it with red boxes and click-to-type text whose font size follows the mouse wheel. `Esc` exits, `Enter` confirms. The annotated image is composited at native resolution and dropped into the composer. Windows 10/11 only (uses Windows PowerShell + WinForms); everything runs locally. ## 用法 两个入口，行为完全一致： - **点输入框工具行的剪刀图标**（模型选择器左侧、语音按钮旁）； - **按 `F1`**：宿主侧注册的**全局热键**，DSH 在后台、焦点在别的应用上也能触发。 进入截图后： 1. 屏幕整体压暗（含任务栏与其他应用），拖动鼠标框选目标区域；松手后选区恢复原亮度，可以拖边角微调、拖框内移动。 2. 选区下方弹出工具条： | 按钮 | 作用 | |---|---| | **Box** | 在选区里拖出**红色方框**外框。可画多个 | | **Text** | 在选区里点一下就地输入文字（回车确认），**滚轮调字号**（8–200 px） | | **Size N** | 当前字号，滚轮会实时变 | | **Done** | 合成并投递 | | **Cancel** | 取消 | 3. 快捷键：`Enter` 确认（还没框选时先按 `Enter` = 整屏）；**`Esc` 退出截图**（正在写字时先取消这条文字）；双击选区内确认。 4. 完成后：标注图按**原分辨率**合成为 PNG，自动作为附件放进当前输入框（同时写剪贴板兜底）。 - 按钮路径：直接回填到那次请求； - `F1` 路径：结果先落到 `%TEMP%\dsh-snip-hotkey\*.ready.png`，页面每 0.9 s 取一张回填（页面最小化时等你切回来再取）。 ## 结构 | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `lib/overlay.ps1` | 全屏浮层本体：定格压暗、框选与手柄、工具条、红框、文字、合成导出。纯 ASCII（PowerShell 5.1 编码坑） | | `lib/hotkey.ps1` | 常驻热键助手：`RegisterHotKey` 抢 F1，按下拉起同一个浮层，结果改名 `.ready.png` 入队；父进程消失即自杀 | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：拉起浮层 / 拉起热键助手 / 结果队列 / 自检路由 | | `client/index.js` | 浏览器半：一颗按钮 + 轮询取热键结果 + 投进输入框（页面里没有截图预览） | | `lib/capture.ps1` | 维护用：一次性整屏抓帧（调试/自检，不参与截图流程） | 结果约定：脚本把 JSON 写到 `-Out` 旁边（`.meta.json`），宿主读文件而不是读 stdout——这样 `spawn` 完全不需要 stdio 管道。 ## 安装 ```sh # npm（收录进市场之后，市场里点安装也是这条） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-snip # 直接从 GitHub 装 dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XXP-AI-SPACE/dsh-snip # 本地开发（link 到源码） dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:F:\工作之后\3-DSH\plugins\dsh-snip" ``` 装完**冷启动桌面端**（宿主半需要），浏览器半刷新页面即可。 发布/收录流程见 [PUBLISH.md](PUBLISH.md)。 ## 自检 ```powershell # 宿主路由是否在 Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-snip/status -UseBasicParsing # 整条链路（浮层会自己画一个样例选区并确认，约 1 秒闪一下） Invoke-WebRequest 'http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-snip/capture?probe=1' -UseBasicParsing # 纯几何自检（不弹窗） powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File lib\overlay.ps1 -SelfTest ``` ## 可调项 - `lib/index.js` 顶部：`HOTKEY_KEY`（默认 `'F1'`，可改 `F2`…`F12`）。 - `client/index.js` 顶部：`SLOT` / `ORDER`（默认 `conversation.input.right` + `1000`，即模型选择器之前；想放最左改成 `conversation.input.left`）。 - `lib/overlay.ps1` 顶部：`$HANDLE`（手柄判定半径）、`$MIN_W/$MIN_H`（最小选区）、颜色与字号上下限在 `Adjust-Font` / 常量区。 ## 热键排查 - 助手日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-snip-hotkey\hotkey.log`（注册成功会写 `hwnd=` 与 `listening: F1`）。 - 如果 `F1` 已被别的程序占用，`RegisterHotKey` 会失败：日志写 `RegisterHotKey failed`，助手退出，`/dsh-snip/status` 里 `hotkey.helperAlive` 为 `false`。换 `HOTKEY_KEY` 即可。 - 助手会盯着 DSH 主进程（`-ParentPid`），应用退出后 300 ms 内自行退出，不会留下孤儿进程或占着 F1。 ## 已知边界 - 浮层是 TopMost 的全屏窗口，会盖住任务栏与所有应用；`Esc` 或 5 分钟空闲会自动退出。 - 它抓的是**浮层出现前**那一帧，所以浮层里的内容不会截到自己。 - 多显示器按虚拟屏幕整体覆盖（负坐标屏也算）。 - 不做：编号角标（1、2、3 号方框）与标注清单、撤销、箭头/椭圆/马赛克。

plugins.description: DSH 自动检测本机 HTTP 代理，通过固定回环入口接入运行中的 DSH，支持设置开关、GitHub HTTPS 检测及关闭恢复。
